verdict: Windows Update install path does not exist. Same family as 0x80070002 but points to a missing directory, often from an interrupted cumulative update install.
fix: Run `DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup` followed by `DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth`. If the client is stuck in `Install Pending`, confirm the last reboot actually completed (`(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime`) before clearing `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending`. Retry the scan after services restart.
